item.title: gokapi: 2.1.0 -> 2.2.3
item.description:
Things done

proxyVendor = true; was added because otherwise the go-modules derivation was failing with go: inconsistent vendoring in /build/source. See the nixpkgs-update logs. I don't know Go well enough to understand how this works, but I saw other Go packages do this when faced with the same issue. For example: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/474420, https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/482927, https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/492383

          Note: When using `nix shell`, `nix build`, `nix develop`, etc with a flake,

              nixpkgs.config.permittedInsecurePackages = [
                "lima-1.2.2"
